scientific.integrity: The proof keeps the practical Sophia momentum state, Hessian EMA, refresh schedule, denominator floor, and clipping rule. On an exact diagonal quadratic, the Hessian state is an explicit deterministic transient and the local unclipped dynamics reduce to independent two-state linear modes with an exact Jury stability calculation.
limitations: The Hessian estimator is exact and the objective Hessian is diagonal in the optimizer coordinates.
The theorem is local and uses constant learning rate with zero weight decay.
Stochastic Hessian noise, scheduled learning rates, clipping-active global dynamics, and off-diagonal curvature are outside scope.
The source hyperparameter comparison is illustrative because the training runs use schedules.

title: Exact floor-limited local spectrum of Sophia on diagonal quadratics
